name: dental-school-life-sim
description: A cozy bilingual (EN/ZH) dental school life-simulation game. Static, GitHub Pages deployable.

scripts._comment: Harness bundles go to node_modules/.cache: always writable, always ignored, and identical on a workstation, an HPC login node, and a CI runner. Never an absolute machine-specific path — CI has no /scratch.
scripts.smoke: npm run tmpdir && esbuild scripts/smoke.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/smoke.bundle.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/smoke.bundle.mjs --quick
scripts.balance: npm run tmpdir && esbuild scripts/smoke.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/balance.bundle.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/balance.bundle.mjs
scripts.validate-content: npm run tmpdir && esbuild content-gen/validate.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/validate.bundle.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/validate.bundle.mjs
scripts.test:migration: npm run tmpdir && esbuild scripts/migration-test.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/migration-test.bundle.mjs && node node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/migration-test.bundle.mjs
scripts.test:render: npm run tmpdir && esbuild scripts/render-smoke.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/render-smoke.bundle.cjs && node node_modules/.cache/dsls-v2/render-smoke.bundle.cjs
